# Playtest diary: r3-typed-01duffy

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** checkpoint 01-duffy
- **Persona:** a millennial who knows text adventures exist but has never finished one
- **Seed:** 26047
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** 46cc742
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 3
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r3-typed-01duffy.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)

**Cmds 1-20.** Woke in the spacetruck with a voice asking for a course. Read the form: a scan of the actual green form with a time:course table. Time on status bar was 5364, so row 5350-5399 = 259. Typed "type 259" and it launched. Loved that. Waited through the trip, docked (+5). Opened the survival kit: orange goo, gray goo, Thermos of blue soup. Ate orange goo (apricot yogurt!). "drink water" not known, fair. Got out; station is empty, which is creepy. Level Five lobby, a Workshop with a bedistor and a creepy welder that follows me, Sick Bay with an ID-locked door east, PX with a vending machine (1 galakmid; only a timer and a drill bit left). North Connection leads to a Sub-Module. I have no money.

**Cmds 21-60.** Sub-Module: Engineering Lab (met Plato, a polite robot who tags along with Floyd), Engineering Office (Schmidt's diary about a billion-year-old alien pyramid), Astro Lab (took fromitz board), Scientists' Quarters, Bio Lab/Office (a torn note: "station is a cell, pyramid is a mechanized bacteriophage..."), Holding Tank (blasted open, empty - the pyramid got out?). "ask plato about station" -> doesn't know the word station. Command Module: Station Control (monitors: comms, food red), Commander's Office with a log reader, Commander's Quarters with a safe (8000-setting dial!) and a log tape. Played the tape: fuel cells locked in the Dome storage bin, key in the safe; a stamp hidden under the bed; village off-limits; welders malfunctioning. I got killed by a welder while listening (my fault for not leaving), undid, saved, then the log reader itself exploded on the last entry. Undid again and fled; tape lost. Looked under the bed: validation stamp. Stamped my form (no points).

**Cmds 61-140.** South Connection has a closed iris hatch with a slot (village? diplomatic module?). Robot Shop: an unborn robot "Oliver" and a heating chamber with a drill bit I couldn't reach - asked Floyd to get it, he burned his hand and dropped it: +3. Got tired; found Level Four barracks, "sleep" on the floor refused, "get in bed" worked; dream, day 2, +3. Everything I carried ended up dropped by the bed (take all tries to pick up Floyd - lol). Auto-doors are now sluggish and slam shut early - something is going wrong with the station. Docking Bay #3: lilac nanofilm spool "Spacetruck Refueling Instructions" - need a reader.

**Cmds 140-242.** Level Three: Gym (exercise machine + sign), Theatre (projection booth), Laundry (washer missing, dryer, presser), Chapel with an eternal flame and a blinking seven-pointed star out of reach, plus a puce spool "Chapel Maintenance". Ate gray goo when hungry. Mess Hall (coffee cup), Main Storage (a detonator with a blackened hyperdiode inside), Library with a voice spool reader: both spools are garbled and end with "You will die, human!" Creepy! Chapel spool mentions a diode in the star - I bet the star's diode replaces the dead one in the detonator. Meeting Rooms 1-2; PA says a deep-space message is waiting at the Comm Center. Dome at the top: storage bin with a newly welded lock, warm to the touch (fuel cells; key in safe). Level Six: Aux Barracks, Officers' Quarters A, Docking Bay #1 with the alien ship. Wall dots + skeleton with a huge tongue case -> LICK DOTS gives a taste-coded message. Loved it. The mayor in the village can apparently translate. Harness command count runs faster than my own count (217 at what felt like ~130).

**Cmds 243-330.** Docking Bay #4 (empty), End of Corridor with another ID-locked security door (my ID card does nothing), a dark Shipping Room, Officers' Quarters B/C. Level Seven = Printing Plant: trash can with a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form, mauve spool; Paper Recycling next door had a drill (small bit). Ladder to Level Eight is sealed from below, with clanging and a giant throbbing heartbeat down there. Drilled the safe: small bit = toothpick hole, medium = pencil hole. Guess I need the Large Drill Bit from the PX vending machine, but no money. Stamped the crumpled form, ironed it in the laundry presser, fed it to the South Connection slot: hatch half-opens, +6 (17). Zero-g village, nobody around. Mayor's Office: "Deciphering Alien Speech" with a crib sheet of taste words. Translated the wall: "Hunji brethren! [legal destruction/sabotage] failed, however I have shined light upon the Zeenak weapon's solitary weakness: element 78! Turn back the deadly radiations! The air is souring." Element 78 is platinum (I know that from chemistry, not the game).

**Cmds 331-395.** Village: Bank (took platinum detector - turned it on, no reading yet), Travel Agency, Greasy Straw (restaurant, empty), Alley hub: Loan Shark (strong box, drill sparked and died on it), Doc Schuster's (an ostrich! and a letter about "ostrich nip" in someone's ceiling panel), Junk Yard (magnetic boots - couldn't carry them, too much stuff), Pawn Shop (spray can of SPORZ spores). Drank the soup - I have no food left, which worries me. Shady Dan's: the ID-card rank machine; set my card to rank 10 Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral (no points; hopefully opens the security doors). Trading Post: FREZONE explosive instructions (hole of right diameter + detonator + timer; keep below 150 K). Warehouse below has a vacuum storage door (opened it). Stopped at 395 with a save in the Trading Post; the welders keep chasing me and I just walk away from them.

## Leg handoff

Ended: Trading Post (village), score 17 of 80, Day 2 ~5048. Saved there (SAVE). Food all eaten (orange goo, gray goo, soup) - find food next.

### Map so far
- Command Module, ladder spine (top to bottom): Dome (L1: locked warm storage bin = fuel cells, air shaft grating) - Mess Hall (L2: N/S both to curved Main Storage; NE Meeting Room 1 -> S Meeting Room 2 -> S Library; SE Library) - Level Three (N Gym, S Theatre, NW Laundry, SW Chapel) - Level Four (N/S barracks, W Docking Bay #3) - Level Five (W Docking Bay #2 = my spacetruck, N Workshop, NE North Junction [E Sick Bay w/ ID door, NE PX, N North Connection: W Storage (dark), E PX, N Tube to Sub-Module], SE South Junction [E Station Control, SE Commander's Office (E Quarters w/ safe, S Briefing Room -> W South Connection), SW File Room (dark), S South Connection: W Robot Shop, S -> village]) - Level Six (NW Docking Bay #1 alien ship, SW Docking Bay #4, N Aux Barracks, S Officers' Qtrs A, SE End of Corridor [N ID security door, E Shipping Room (dark), S/SW Officers' Qtrs C/B]) - Level Seven Printing Plant (NW Paper Recycling) - Level Eight ladder sealed from below.
- Sub-Module (N of North Connection): Scientists' Qtrs / Astro Lab+Office / Engineering Lab+Office / Bio Lab+Office / Holding Tank (blasted open, pyramid gone).
- Village (zero-g, S of South Connection via Grimy Passage): Main Street (up Mayor's Office, NE Greasy Straw, S Bank, W Travel Agency, SE Alley). Alley: S Loan Shark, SE Doc Schuster's, E Junk Yard (up Shady Dan's -> NW Trading Post -> down Warehouse with vacuum door), SW Pawn Shop.
- Items left around: diary+note (Main Storage), spools lilac/puce (Mess Hall), mauve spool (Printing Plant, unread), small bit (Commander's Qtrs), letter (Junk Yard), 12-prong fromitz board (Trading Post), magnetic boots (Junk Yard). Floyd carries coffee, textbook, crib paper.

### Puzzles solved
Course heading (259 from form table), docking (+5), drill bit via Floyd from heating chamber (+3), sleep (+3), village entry form: trash can -> stamp (under Commander's bed) -> presser -> slot (+6). Alien wall message: LICK DOTS + crib paper = "element 78 (platinum) is the Zeenak weapon's weakness". ID card upgraded to rank 10.

### Open puzzles and theories
- Safe (key to Dome bin with fuel cells): pencil-diameter hole drilled. Plan: FREZONE explosive (from the vacuum storage below the Warehouse, must stay cold) in the hole + detonator + timer (All-Purpose Timer at the PX, costs 1 galakmid - no money yet; maybe the Bank/Loan Shark strong box). Detonator's hyperdiode is blackened: replace with the diode from the Chapel's blinking star (spool says "...iode in the Chapel's star").
- Security doors (Sick Bay E, Level Six End of Corridor N): try the rank-10 ID card.
- Dark rooms (Storage, File Room, Shipping Room): need a light.
- Pyramid escaped, sabotaging machines (welders, doors, log readers, spool readers say "You will die, human"). Platinum detector should find platinum to use against it.
- Oliver the unborn robot; Comm Center deep-space message waiting (not found Comm Center yet); ostrich and "ostrich nip" in someone's ceiling panel; spore spray can; Gym machine sign; Theatre projection booth.

Memory note: nothing here came from remembering the game; element 78 = platinum is general chemistry knowledge.

### What I would try next
Go to Sick Bay / End of Corridor with the new ID card; explore the vacuum storage (need suit? magnetic boots?); find food; find money for the PX timer; get the star's diode (Floyd can reach high things?).

# Playtest diary: r3-typed-03village

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** checkpoint 03-village
- **Persona:** a 14-year-old who has never played a text adventure, used to phone games
- **Seed:** 97
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** 46cc742
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 3
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r3-typed-03village.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Cmds 1-25.** Woke up in Grimy Passage with two robot buddies (Floyd, Plato). Went north, grabbed a form and a stamp, then a welder robot came at me "quivering with excitement" so I ran back south. South is a whole space village with nobody in it: Main Street, Bank (took a platinum detector, turned it on, nothing happened yet), Travel Agency, Mayor's Office (textbook with a secret paper of taste-words, copied to my scratch notes), Greasy Straw (there's Fire Nectar behind the counter, didn't take it yet), Trading Post (fromitz board + explosive instructions: needs a hole, a detonator and a timer. I HAVE a detonator!).

**Cmds 26-45.** Warehouse under the Trading Post has an airlock. I closed the top door and opened the bottom one and my lungs exploded lol. Undo saved me and it told me to SAVE, so I did. Alley goes everywhere. Loan Shark has a strong box with a huge lock. Drilled it but my bit only makes a toothpick hole. Footnotes are funny. Theory: bigger bit, or put explosive in the hole.

**Cmds 46-80.** Alley branches: Missionary (N, nothing), Pawn Shop (SW, spray can of SPORZ spores), Doc Schuster's (SE, an ostrich! and a letter saying ostrich nip is in someone's ceiling panel), Junk Yard (E, magnetic boots). The carrying limit is really annoying: it told me dropping one thing would make room, then I fumbled stuff anyway, and then it wouldn't let me grab boots with 6 items. Wore the boots so they stop counting.

**Cmds 81-115.** Up from Junk Yard is Shady Dan's (machine with keypad and a tiny slot, off). Trading Post north -> Grocery (bag of vacuum taffy). Detector got warmer and warmer, BEEPS in the Barbershop (east of Grocery; big mirror). I got super tired; SLEEP said beds only, but I didn't find one, so I passed out on Broadway, had a funny dream and got +3 (score 14). Dropped everything in my sleep. Grabbed it back, plus a headlamp from the Field Office (east of Broadway). Recruitment Office north of Broadway, Rec Shop northeast.
**Cmds 116-170.** Smashed the barbershop mirror: platinum foil behind it (+4, 18). Saloon (SE of Grocery) -> Casino, where the detector got too hot and I dropped it. Spinning the roulette wheel opened exits up and north (+4, 22). Up = Flophouse (beds! too late) with a locker holding a SPACE SUIT. North = Opium Den (sign w/ mustache). Hungry: can't eat in a space suit (lol), took it off, ate orange goo, which fixed hunger+thirst. Then wore the suit, went through the airlock (+3, 25): the vacuum ate my gray goo and the nectar. Headlamp on, found the FREZONE explosive, put it in the Thermos and closed it (keep it cold - sheet said under 150K). Now I need a hole and a timer.
**Cmds 171-215.** At the Loan Shark I wanted to put the explosive into the drilled hole, but that step did not go through for me this leg (session tool issue, not the game), so I left the explosive safely in the closed Thermos and explored instead. Broadway down = Fortune Teller (crystal ball tells you to "wave" hands, but the game doesn't know "wave"). Broadway west = Makeshift Connector; its iris hatch is too narrow for the space suit (probably back to the station). Welder #2 roams Broadway. Broadway SW = Pet Store: Arcturian balloon creature in a cage; eats spores. Opened cage, SPRAY CAN makes it gobble; can't hold its leash in the suit glove; bare-handed it farts in my face and I drop everything (lol). Left the space suit in the Pet Store. Took vacuum taffy (food for later). Rec Shop simulation booth = flavour only.
**Cmds 216-260.** The letter's "ceiling panel" was in the Pet Store: LOOK AT CEILING reveals a panel, it holds ostrich nip (+3, 28). Welder #3 chased me off. Gave the nip to the ostrich at Doc's: it got drunk and passed out (maybe I should have led it somewhere instead; it sniffed toward me when I carried the nip). Headlamp is dimming, turned it off. Shady Dan's machine: turned it on, put my ID card in: "card data is scrambled" + footnote GOTCHA AGAIN. I think wearing the magnetic boots with the card in my pocket did it, but nothing said so at the time. Stamped the Assignment Completion Form (just "Done."). Looked at the form paper: it has an astrogator time->course chart, probably for flying the spacetruck home later.
**Cmds 261-290.** Went back north into the station (gravity again). South Connection E = Briefing Room -> N Commander's Office (log reader, turned on, no tape) -> N Station Control (monitors: comms/food/printing RED) -> NE East Connection -> NW Sick Bay (security door with ID reader: my card is "damaged, see the Security Officer"). W = North Junction, N = North Connection, N Tube, N Engineering Lab. Eng Office: Prof. Schmidt's diary (billion-year-old alien pyramid; wall dots decoded by non-visual properties, the mayor has linguistic training = my taste paper!). Astro Lab (up): twenty-prong fromitz board (took). Scientists' Quarters (top): cubicles = beds for tonight. Bio Office (down): bloody note "station is a cell, pyramid is a mechanized bacterioph..." CREEPY. So the pyramid is making the machines go crazy.
**Cmds 291-326.** Holding Tank Level (bottom of the sub-module): the tank was blasted open, empty (the pyramid got out). North Connection W = Storage (dark; headlamp on): a JAMMER with twenty sockets, freq 0-1400, set 337. I went to plug in the twenty-prong fromitz board... and it's GONE from my inventory, no message ever. Walked back looking, never found it. Ate the vacuum taffy (hunger fixed). Then in the Bio Lab PLATO shot me with a stun ray and monologued: the pyramid is a Zeenak weapon that turns machines against their makers and builds copies. I said "floyd, help me", Floyd knocked the gun away, it blew up Plato (+7, 35). Floyd is sobbing. Welder #1 arrived; fled up. Headlamp battery died.
**Cmds 327-370.** North Connection E = The PX: Vendo-Matic machine, 1 galakmid each, only #6 All-Purpose Timer and #9 Large Drill Bit left! Those are exactly what the explosive needs (timer + bigger hole). I have NO coin. Workshop (N of Level Five) had a twenty-ohm bedistor (took). Spacetruck in Docking Bay #2: radio says "Breaker. Over." but I couldn't answer (SAY HELLO not understood); left the taffy bag and stamp in the truck. Level Four: barracks (nothing), Docking Bay #3 lilac nanofilm spool ("Spacetruck Refueling Instructions"). Level Three: Gym sign says the exercise machine talks on frequency 710 - don't bring anything broadcasting on it (= jammer set to 710?!). Chapel: blinking star out of reach, puce spool ("Chapel Maintenance Procedures"). Auto-doors keep nearly nipping my heels - scary, getting worse.
**Cmds 371-388.** Laundry: dryer empty, the presser started billowing steam at me (machine going evil?), left. Theatre (S of Level Three): projection booth locked. Mess Hall (up from Level Three): coffee on a table; the rooms around it loop (Main Storage N and S, Meeting Room 1 NE). Saved in Meeting Room 1. Tried to take the coffee and fumbled the puce spool - both are on the Mess Hall floor. Ending the leg here at ~388 commands, score 35.

Memory note: I recognised the Plato betrayal and Floyd from Planetfall only vaguely; the screen told me everything I acted on. I did remember that Stationfall has a pyramid and that machines turn hostile, which is why I ran from welders.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
**Village (zero-gee, south of station):** Grimy Passage (N = station South Connection, S = Main Street). Main Street: U Mayor's Office, NE Greasy Straw, S Bank, W Travel Agency, SE Alley. Bank NW = Travel Agency. Greasy Straw NE = Trading Post. Trading Post: D Warehouse, N Grocery, NW Pet Store, SE Shady Dan's (via NW from Dan's), E Saloon. Warehouse: D Airlock -> D In Space (vac yard; need suit + boots + light), SW Alley. Alley: S Loan Shark, N Missionary, SW Pawn Shop, SE Doc Schuster's, E Junk Yard (U Shady Dan's), NW Main Street. Grocery: N Broadway, E Barbershop, SE Saloon. Saloon E Casino (after spinning roulette: U Flophouse, N Opium Den). Broadway: N Recruitment Office, NE Rec Shop, E Field Office, D Fortune Teller, SW Pet Store, SE Barbershop, W Makeshift Connector (to East Connection; space suit too bulky for its hatch).
**Station:** South Connection: E Briefing Room -> N Commander's Office -> N Station Control -> NE East Connection -> NW Sick Bay (security door E needs a working ID) -> W North Junction. North Junction N = North Connection: N Tube -> Engineering Lab (N office; U Astro Lab/office, U Scientists' Quarters; D Bio Lab/office, D Holding Tank). North Connection W Storage (dark, JAMMER), E The PX (Vendo-Matic). North Junction SW Level Five: N Workshop (N = dark Storage), W Docking Bay #2 (spacetruck). Ladder: Level Four (barracks N/S, W Docking Bay #3), Level Three (N Gym, SW Chapel, NW Laundry, S Theatre), Mess Hall above (N/S Main Storage, NE Meeting Room 1).
**Where my stuff is:** space suit + cage + balloon creature in Pet Store; fromitz 12-prong board + dice in Flophouse; detector in Casino; textbook + instruction sheet in Pawn Shop; letter at Doc's; diary in Eng Office; taffy bag + stamp in spacetruck; puce spool + coffee in Mess Hall. Carrying: explosive in the closed Thermos (in survival kit), detonator, drill (small bit), foil, spray can, bedistor, lilac spool, ID card (scrambled), form (stamped), taste paper.

### Puzzles solved
- Platinum detector hot/cold -> break barbershop mirror -> reflective foil (+4)
- Spin roulette wheel -> Flophouse + Opium Den (+4); space suit in Flophouse locker
- Suit + boots + headlamp through the airlock -> vac yard explosive (+3); keep it in the closed Thermos
- Look at Pet Store ceiling -> panel -> ostrich nip (+3); gave it to the ostrich (now drunk; maybe wrong use)
- Sleeping anywhere gave +3 (day 2)
- Plato's stun-ray ambush: "floyd, help me" -> Plato destroyed (+7)

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Loan Shark strong box:** small bit drills a toothpick hole. Large drill bit + All-Purpose Timer are in the PX Vendo-Matic for 1 galakmid each. Need COINS - have not found any. Then explosive + detonator + timer in the hole.
- **Jammer (Storage W of North Connection, dark):** 20 sockets; the twenty-prong board from the Astro Lab vanished from my inventory without a message (maybe Plato took it?). Gym sign: exercise machine uses frequency 710 - set jammer to 710 to protect/attack it?
- **ID card is scrambled** (probably the magnetic boots). Shady Dan's machine alters cards but not scrambled ones. Sick Bay security door needs a good card; "see the Security Officer".
- **Balloon creature:** eats spores (SPRAY CAN makes it feed). Can't grab the leash in zero-gee (it farts, you drop everything) and the suit glove won't fit. Maybe needs gravity.
- **Log reader** (Commander's Office, on) needs a log tape. Nanofilm spools need some reader.
- Chapel star blinks, out of reach. Theatre projection booth locked. Radio in truck says "Breaker. Over." - couldn't reply.
- Taste paper decodes the alien pyramid's dots (Schmidt's diary + Mayor's textbook).

### What I would try next
1. Hunt for a galakmid coin (casino tables? Bank? pockets in laundry/barracks? Loan Shark?). Buy the timer and the large bit at the PX.
2. Find a light (headlamp dead) for the dark Storage; look for the twenty-prong board (maybe where Plato went) and set up the jammer.
3. Bring the balloon creature into gravity somehow; find what the bedistor and fromitz boards fit.
4. Keep saving - auto-doors are closing faster and welders roam.

# Playtest diary: r3-typed-06plato

- **Start:** checkpoint 06-plato
- **Persona:** someone who played Planetfall on an Apple II in 1983 and loved Floyd, but never played the sequel
- **Seed:** 81554
- **Conveniences:** on

- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)

**Cmds 1-10.** Woke in a Warehouse with Floyd and a bookish robot, Plato. A red sign: vacuum storage below. Suit and mag boots on, so down through the airlock. Opening the outer door freeze-dried the goo in my survival kit; undo only reaches one move, so it's gone. Just like old Floyd defending me in Planetfall, Floyd tackled the gun and Plato blew himself up. Floyd is sobbing on the floor; I nearly cried too. Meanwhile the explosive warmed and sublimed away. Everything I carried floated off; took it all back. Theory: need a fresh explosive kept cold (Thermos?) and the vendor's instruction sheet.


**Cmds 23-60.** Main Street's Mayor's Office had "Deciphering Alien Speech" with a slip of paper: a taste-based alien vocabulary (bttr/salty/sweet... = Hunji, Zeenak, weapon, sabotage, 7/8). The Trading Post had the FREZONE instruction sheet: insert in hole, attach detonator + timer, keep below 150K. Too late. Hunger warnings began. Handy fumble hint when carrying 8+ things. Floyd is getting surly: stomping my foot, cursing my ancestors, muttering about robots ruling humans. The pyramid is getting to him. Oh no.

**Cmds 60-100.** Went back to the vac yard for another explosive: none. Saved. Hull welders roam and seem hostile. Now ravenous, heading into the station (had to shed the suit at the iris) to find the Mess Hall. Found the Robot Shop (sleeping robot Oliver, heating chamber) and Briefing Room off South Connection.

**Cmds 100-117.** Died of hunger in the station Laundry at 61 points, never found the Mess Hall. Also learned levels are numbered downward (Level Six below Five, Printing Plant below that). Game gave a proper Infocom death screen.

**Restart from checkpoint (cmds 118-150).** Treated it as reloading my old save. This time Plato pulled the gun right away. Waiting = Floyd fled and I died; undo, then "floyd, help me" and Floyd tackled the gun. So talking to Floyd matters. Saved. Went to the vac yard with the Thermos, put the explosive straight in and closed it: no melting since. Saved again. Got the platinum detector (it beeps quietly in the Bank), ate the orange goo (tasted like apricot yogurt). Nice note: gray goo refused with 'in about 101 moves'.

**Cmds 150-205.** Detector beeps 'quietly' everywhere, even with everything else dropped, so it isn't something I carry. Fortune Teller under Broadway: crystal ball is a con-artist joke. Down the ladder from the Printing Plant (Level Seven) the passage to Level Eight is sealed from below; the elevator whines but won't go to 8. Air is souring." Element 78 = platinum. So: find platinum with the detector, take it to the pyramid (probably on sealed Level Eight). Floyd keeps getting meaner.

**Cmds 205-265.** Detector started 'getting warm' so I switch it off between checks. Swept the village with it: Rec Shop, Field Office, Barbershop, Saloon, Casino, Flophouse (vacuum taffy in a bag), Opium Den, Loan Shark, Pawn Shop, Doc Schuster's (letter: ostrich nip is in someone's ceiling panel), Junk Yard, Shady Dan's (a jerry-built machine with keypad and tiny slot). The detector says 'quietly beeping' in every single room, so it gives me no gradient at all. Frustrating; I'm burning moves.

**Cmds 265-305.** Shady Dan's machine said my ID card is scrambled; the footnote teased Planetfall magnet victims (I laughed). Studio 'junk yard' joke; sculpture has a J-series hyperdiode (I carry an M-series). Pet Store: empty cage, ceiling panel already open, no ostrich nip. Ate the gray goo in the station. Zapped the ladder: nothing (wasted charge 6). Rhythmic mechanical heartbeat throbs from below: factory on Level Eight? Elevator won't go to 8 or 9, but goes to 1: the Dome, with an air-shaft grating (fixed) and a locked 'Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies' bin, lock newly welded on, bin warm. Theory: explosive in the bin's lock, but I have no detonator yet.

**Cmds 305-345.** Level Two: Mess Hall (coffee on a table), Main Storage (wraps round), Meeting Rooms 1 and 2, Library (spool reader; terminal removed). Noticed my ID card is gone: I left it in Shady Dan's machine. Commander's Quarters (Level Five, east of Commander's Office): a detonator, a drill with medium bit, a small (toothpick) bit, a log tape, and a safe with an 8000-setting dial and a pencil-sized hole. That's where the explosive goes! Saved, attached detonator to timer, opened the Thermos: just a puff of FREZONE gas. It had sublimed silently inside the Thermos at some point. My only save was after that. Crushed.

**Cmds 345-400.** Log tape in the Office's log reader: fuel cells are locked in the Dome bin and the bin KEY is in the safe; the pyramid was moved to the holding tank in the Sci Sub-Module; Shady Dan sells modified Patrol IDs; the stamp is under the Commander's bed; welders and plant machinery went rogue. North Connection > Tube > Sci Sub-Module: Engineering Lab (welder #2 menaced me), Bio Lab, Bio Office (bloodied note: 'think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacteriophage'), Astro Lab, Holding Tank Level: tank blasted open and empty. The detector went SILENT in the Sub-Module, so its 'quiet beep' means platinum somewhere in the Command Module/village. Got sleepy, slept in a Female Barracks bed (Level Four); dreamt of Captain Fussbottom's forms. Woke Novem 6; my chronometer had stopped. Leg ends here, score 61 of 80.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
Levels count DOWNWARD. Elevator (east of each lobby) takes typed levels 1-7; 8 and 9 refuse. Ladder links lobbies.
- L1 Dome: locked warm bin (fuel cells; key in safe), air-shaft grating (fixed).
- L2 Mess Hall; N/S Main Storage; NE Meeting Room 1 > S Meeting Room 2 > S Library > W Mess Hall.
- L3 lobby: N Gym (exercise machine), S Theatre, SW Chapel (extinguished eternal flame, switch in pulpit, spray can, star, balloon creature, puce spool), NW Laundry.
- L4: N Female Barracks (beds), S barracks, W Docking Bay #3.
- L5 lobby: NE North Junction (N North Connection > N Tube > Sci Sub-Module: Engineering Lab, up Astro Lab, down Bio Lab (N Bio Office), down Holding Tank - empty); SE South Junction > SE Commander's Office (log reader) > E Commander's Quarters (safe, drill, bits, detonator; I left hyperdiode+foil there); South Junction S South Connection (E Briefing Room, W Robot Shop: Oliver, heating chamber). East Junction E East Connection > E Makeshift Connector (no suit through the iris) > Broadway (village).
- L6: NW Docking Bay #1 (alien ship: pedestal, skeleton, taste-dots). L7 Printing Plant (NW Paper Recycling); ladder to L8 sealed from below.
- Village: Broadway (N Recruitment, NE Rec Shop, E Field Office, SE Barbershop, S Grocery, down Fortune Teller, SW Pet Store). Grocery S Trading Post (W Studio, E Saloon > E Casino (up Flophouse, N Opium Den), down Warehouse > airlock > vac yard). Warehouse SW Alley (S Loan Shark, SW Pawn Shop, SE Doc Schuster's, E Junk Yard > up Shady Dan's > NW Trading Post), Alley up Main Street (up Mayor's Office - my space suit is here, W Travel Agency > SE Bank, NE Greasy Straw > NE Trading Post).

### Puzzles solved
- Plato's betrayal: when stunned, say "floyd, help me" on the last turn; waiting = death.
- Vac yard: suit+boots, close inner door, open outer, headlamp reveals the FREZONE explosive (+3).
- Alien dots: LICK DOTS, decode with the Mayor's paper: element 78 (platinum) turns back the pyramid's radiation.
- Log tape: key to the Dome bin is in the Commander's safe; pyramid gone from the holding tank.

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Explosive lost (twice).** It sublimes above 150K after ~100 millichrons. The closed Thermos did NOT keep it (no warnings shown while sealed). Only one explosive seen. Game is probably unwinnable from here; next tester may want the checkpoint again. Theory: carry it cold another way, or fetch it last and run (long trip from vac yard to Commander's Quarters), or the heating chamber/ something cools it.
- Safe: explosive in the pencil hole + detonator + timer, then leave; key inside opens the Dome bin (fuel cells, for a ship/spacetruck?).
- Level Eight sealed; heartbeat throbbing below - the pyramid's factory. Platinum needed: detector beeps quietly everywhere in Command Module/village but silent in Sci Sub-Module.
- Floyd is turning (stomps, curses); jammer (0-1400, set 710) may block the pyramid's signal on him/welders.
- Shady Dan's machine (keypad+slot) makes IDs; my scrambled ID card is in it.
- Hull welders roam and menace.

### What I would try next
Restore (save is in Female Barracks? No: last SAVE was in Commander's Quarters, explosive already gone). If allowed, re-run checkpoint 06-plato: say "floyd, help me" during Plato's speech, fetch the explosive LAST, and try getting it to the safe fast (maybe via elevator). Then Dome bin > fuel cells; find platinum; jammer; Level Eight.

# Playtest diary: r3-click-02station

- **Mode:** click
- **Start:** checkpoint 02-station
- **Persona:** an adult who played Zork in the 1980s but has never played this game
- **Seed:** 2760
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** 46cc742
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 3
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r3-click-02station.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Cmds 1-15.** Woke in the docked spacetruck with Floyd. Opened the survival kit (orange goo, gray goo, Thermos), got up, opened the hatch, went out to Docking Bay #2 and east into Level Five lobby. Workshop north had a twenty-ohm bedistor (took it); Storage beyond is pitch black, so I need a light. Sick Bay has a security door with an ID reader; my own card does nothing ("Nothing happens"). Finding the reader in the card's Put in… list failed; only the reader's own Put in… offered the card.

**Cmds 16-40.** East Connection (iris hatch + slot to a military sub-module), Comm Center (emergency beacon, left alone), Station Control (board: communication and food production RED, printing yellow). Commander's Office has a fixed log reader; Commander's Quarters has a 8000-setting safe and a log tape. Ate orange goo as hunger approached. Played the tape: fuel cells locked in Dome storage bin, key in safe; alien pyramid moved to Sci Sub-Module holding tank; stamp hidden under the bed. Met Plato, a gentle robot who follows us. A hull welder seemed menacing; I fled east. Looked under the bed and got the validation stamp. My Assignment Completion Form presumably wants stamping.

**Cmds 41-70.** Stamped my Assignment form (Validate… on the stamp; nothing visible, no points). Right then an explosion: the office log reader blew up (the log did say it was overheating), taking the tape with it. Undo only goes back one step, so I lost the rest of the log. Robot Shop: dormant robot Oliver and a heating chamber holding a medium drill bit; told Floyd to fetch it (+3). South Junction ring done; File Room SW is dark. North Connection leads to the PX (vending machine: timer and large drill bit, 1 galakmid each; I have no coins) and a tube to the Science Sub-Module: Engineering Lab/Office (Schmidt's diary: pyramid over a billion years old; alien dots decoded by nonvisual means; "the mayor" has linguistic training), Astro Lab (took a fromitz board), Bio Office (bloody unfinished note: station as a cell, pyramid as a mechanized bacteriophage), Holding Tank blasted open and empty. Slept in Scientists' Quarters (+3, score 11, now Novem 5).

**Cmds 71-177.** Level Four: barracks (nothing), Docking Bay #3 (lilac nanofilm spool). Auto-doors are now "sluggish" and snap shut early: something is wrong with the station's machines. Ate the gray goo; only the Thermos is left and the Food Units spray acid instead of breakfast. Level Three: Gym (sign: exercise machine talks on frequency 710; don't bring a 710 transmitter near it), Theatre (locked projection booth), Laundry (dryer, presser, washer missing), Chapel (puce spool; pulpit hides a switch for the eternal flame; seven-pointed star blinks out of reach). Level Two: Mess Hall, Main Storage (detonator with a blackened hyperdiode; left the cold coffee there), Meeting Rooms, Library. Both spools play manuals that dissolve into "You will die, human!" The puce one says the chapel star uses a hyperdiode, so that is my replacement part if I can reach the star. Dome on top: locked, warm storage bin (fuel cells, per the log) and an air shaft grating. Welders keep stalking me; I step away and they leave. A P.A. says a deep-space message is waiting at the Comm Center.

**Cmds 178-255.** Comm Center message: my assignment is cancelled, "return to Duffy" (ha). Level Six: auxiliary barracks, officers' quarters A/B/C, End of Corridor (another ID-reader security door north; dark Shipping Room east), Docking Bay #4 (empty), Docking Bay #1 with the alien ship: brittle skeleton with an oversized tongue case, empty pedestal, wall of dots. Tasting the dots gives a flavour transcription (copied below); presumably for "the mayor". Level Seven: Printing Plant (trash can with an Illegal Space Village Entry Form, which I validated with the stamp; mauve spool "Collater Repair Manual") and Paper Recycling (a drill with a small bit). The ladder to Level Eight is sealed from below and the elevator refuses 8; clanging and a throbbing "mechanical heart" come from down there. Theatre booth: locked, and the drill's Drill… list doesn't offer the lock. Chapel star: pulpit sways if climbed; Floyd is too short, Plato "would need to be several meters taller". The Thermos holds blue soup: my last meal.

**Cmds 256-310.** Drilled the Commander's safe: small bit makes a toothpick hole, medium bit enlarges it to pencil size (the PX sells a large bit). No explosive yet. Ate the blue soup. Put the crumpled village form in the Laundry presser, closed it and turned it on; waiting beside it, the presser grabbed my arm and killed me (score 11 of 80). Undid, saved, left the room while it steamed, came back, turned it off, and got a neatly ironed form. The spacetruck's autopilot slot rejects it ("Improper form for this location"; the truck radio has no microphone). The South Connection slot takes it: the iris hatch half-opens (+6, score 17) onto a grimy weightless tube to a deserted space village. Main Street; Mayor's Office up, holding "Deciphering Alien Speech" with a crib sheet inside. My decoding of the dots with it: "Hunji brethren! Sabotage failed. However, I have discovered the Zeenak weapon's solitary weakness: element 78 [platinum]! Turn back the deadly radiations! The air is souring..." So the pyramid is a weapon and platinum stops it.

**Cmds 311-394.** Village: Greasy Straw (cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar behind the counter, left there), Trading Post (sign: FREZONE liquid explosive for sale; instruction sheet: put the explosive in a hole of the right diameter, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, vamoose; keep it below 150 K), Grocery (vacuum taffy in a bag = food), Broadway, Recruitment Office, Field Office (headlamp, now worn: my light), Rec Shop (simulation booths, off), Barbershop (mirror), Pet Store (Arcturian balloon creature on a leash in a cage). Opening the cage lets it out; grabbing the leash in zero-gee makes it fart in my face and I drop everything. Restored. The Tell Floyd menu offers no "take leash". The Studio sculpture holds a J-series hyperdiode, now in the detonator in place of the blackened one. (The Studio/Junk Yard swapped-name intro is a joke, not a bug.) Warehouse: an airlock down to "vacuum storage". Alley; "Doc" Schuster's (ostrich nearly 3 m tall; letter: ostrich nip is in someone's ceiling panel). Junk Yard: magnetic boots. Wearing them scrambled my ID card ("GOTCHA AGAIN!"), so I restored and left the boots there. Shady Dan's ID machine: turn it on, put the card in, type 10 on the keypad: card is now rank 10, Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral (no points yet). Bank: platinum detector, taken and switched on. Saved in the Bank.

Taste transcription of the dots: (sweet/slightly-bitter) (sweet/very-sour) / (sweet/very-sweet) (sour/bland/bland/sour) (very-salty) (very-sweet/bland/sour) (bland) (bland/salty/sour) (bitter/sour/very-sour) (slightly-sour) (bitter/salty/bitter) / (very-sweet/very-salty) (spicy-hot/bland/bland) (very-sweet) / (sour/bland/sour/sweet) (bland) (very-salty/salty/sour) (very-sweet) / (bland/bitter) (bland/sour/very-sour) (very-salty).

## Leg handoff

Memory, not the screen, played a part only twice: I half-remembered that the safe opens with explosives and that the village held Shady Dan's ID trick. Everything else I read off the screen.

Leg 1 ended at command 394 of 400. **Score 17 of 80**, day 2 (Novem 5), time ~5934, in the village Bank. One death (the Laundry presser), undone. Latest save is in the Bank; the Restore… list keeps several. Hunger in ~27 moves: eat the vacuum taffy (in the plastic bag). Tired in ~71 moves: there are beds in the station.

### Map so far
- **Level 1 (Dome):** Dome (locked, warm storage bin holding the fuel cells, per the log; air shaft grating; paths loop back). Ladder and elevator.
- **Level 2:** Mess Hall (Food Units spray acid; lilac spool dropped here), Main Storage N/S (cold coffee dropped), Meeting Room 1 NE, Meeting Room 2 S of that, Library SE (nanofilm reader, magazine, puce spool in the reader).
- **Level 3:** Gym N (exercise machine; sign warns about frequency 710), Theatre S (locked projection booth), Laundry NW (killer presser, dryer), Chapel SW (pulpit hides a flame switch; blinking star out of reach, which per the puce spool holds a hyperdiode).
- **Level 4:** Female Barracks N, SanFac, Male Barracks S, Docking Bay #3 W.
- **Level 5:** Docking Bay #2 W (my spacetruck), Workshop N, Storage N of that (dark), North Junction NE: Sick Bay E (ID-reader security door east), PX NE (vending machine: timer and large drill bit, 1 galakmid each), North Connection N, then Tube to the Science Sub-Module (Engineering, Astro and Bio labs and offices, Scientists' Quarters on top, Holding Tank at the bottom, blasted open). East Junction, East Connection (military iris hatch plus slot), Comm Center S, Station Control SW, Commander's Office S (log reader exploded), Commander's Quarters E (safe, now drilled to pencil size; small bit left there), Briefing Room S, South Connection (iris hatch now open to the village), Robot Shop W (dormant Oliver, heating chamber), South Junction, File Room SW (dark).
- **Level 6:** Auxiliary Barracks N, Officers' Quarters A/B/C, End of Corridor (security door N with ID reader; Shipping Room E, dark), Docking Bay #1 NW (alien ship: skeleton, pedestal, dots), Docking Bay #4 SW.
- **Level 7:** Printing Plant, Paper Recycling NW. Ladder to Level 8 sealed from below; the elevator refuses 8.
- **Village (zero-gee, south of South Connection):** Grimy Passage, Main Street (Mayor's Office up; Greasy Straw NE, then Trading Post NE; Bank S; W unexplored; SE/Down is the Alley). Trading Post: Grocery N, then Broadway N (Recruitment N, Field Office E, Rec Shop NE, Barbershop SE, Pet Store SW; W, NW and Down unexplored). Trading Post also has Studio W, Shady Dan's SE, Warehouse down (vacuum-storage airlock), E unexplored. Alley: Doc Schuster's SE, Junk Yard E (then Shady Dan's up); N, S, SW and W unexplored. Bank: NW unexplored.

### Puzzles solved
- Floyd fetched the medium drill bit from the heating chamber (+3). Slept (+3).
- Found the validation stamp under the Commander's bed. Validated the crumpled village form, flattened it in the presser (leave the room while it runs), and put it in the South Connection slot (+6).
- Decoded the alien dots with the Mayor's crib sheet: platinum (element 78) is the pyramid-weapon's weakness.
- Replaced the detonator's blackened hyperdiode with the Studio's J-series one.
- Raised my ID card to rank 10 at Shady Dan's (keep it away from the magnetic boots).
- Picked up light (headlamp), food (taffy) and a platinum detector.

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Commander's safe** (key to the Dome fuel bin inside): get FREZONE at the Trading Post (the Warehouse vacuum storage may keep it cold below 150 K; use the boots in there?), maybe enlarge the hole with the PX large bit, then explosive, detonator and timer. The PX timer needs a galakmid coin.
- **Security doors** (Sick Bay E, Level 6 End of Corridor N) and the military iris hatch slot: try the rank-10 card now.
- **Pyramid** is loose (the holding tank was blasted). Machines are going haywire (welders, doors, presser, food units, spools saying "You will die, human!"): the pyramid is sabotaging the station. The platinum detector should find platinum to use against it.
- **Chapel star:** too high for me, Floyd or Plato; the pulpit sways. Maybe the ostrich (3 m) or the balloon creature. The ostrich nip is in someone's ceiling panel.
- **Balloon creature:** it can't be held in zero-gee without farting. Try in station gravity, or with the magnetic boots on, or have a robot hold it.
- Theatre booth lock, dark Storage, File Room and Shipping Room (now lit by the headlamp), Level 8 (sealed), Oliver waking up, the gym's 710 frequency (the truck radio has no microphone), and fuel cells for the truck.

### What I would try next
Eat the taffy when hungry. Sweep the unexplored village exits with the detector on. Go back to the station and try the rank-10 card in the Sick Bay and End of Corridor readers and the East Connection slot. Light up Storage, File Room and Shipping Room with the headlamp. Then chase FREZONE, a coin and the timer for the safe.

Pawn Shop: a can of spore spray (balloon creature food). Casino (roulette, dice), Opium Den: nothing. Grocery shelves bare, no food; I'm hungry in ~34 moves and have nothing left to eat but a cup of nectar I left in Level Five Storage. Heading back for it.

Sitting on it scares it; giving it the nip knocks it out drunk (it lies in the Chapel now, and it no longer follows). My theory that a 3 m ostrich could reach the star did not pan out. Back at the Pet Store: spraying and then walking away does not make the creature follow; Push does nothing; and "Tell Floyd to…" only offers hello/follow/help/drop, so I cannot ask the robot, who has no nose, to hold the leash (filed). Nested menus closing after a refused entry cost me three extra calls. Shady Dan's "innocuous machine" is an ID rank changer: my card already says rank 8, Admiral (done on day 1, I suppose). Tired in ~33 moves: going to find a bed.

Plato, now under the pyramid's control, stuns me and gives a villain speech (Zeenak pyramid, a weapon against the Hunji; the station is building replicas). Paralysed, I could only speak; the Tell Floyd menu grew "Save you / Turn off Plato / Take the stun ray". Floyd dithered for three turns, then knocked the gun away and Plato blew up (+7, 33). Very well done. The Flophouse locker has a SPACE SUIT (dropped the jammer there for room). Wearing it, I cycled the Warehouse airlock and went out into the "vac yard" (+3, 36): headlamp on, a tiny cylinder of FREZONE explosive. Put it in the Thermos and closed it. Walked to the Loan Shark: the strong box offers no hole or lock to put the explosive in, and I have no timer and no working drill. Saved there. Leg ends at 387 commands.

## Leg handoff

**Score 36 of 80. Day 3 (Novem 6) morning, at the Loan Shark (village), game saved there. Not won.** Floyd is with me; Plato is dead.

### Map so far
- **Station (gravity), by level (the Blueprint 2 paper lists every level's rooms):**
  - L1 Dome: garden; locked "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies" bin (I drilled a toothpick-sized hole in it); air shaft grating. Ladder down to the Mess Hall.
  - L2: Mess Hall (the food unit sprays ACID; cold coffee), N/S Main Storage, NE Meeting Room 1, S Meeting Room 2, S Library (nanofilm reader; the mauve, puce and lilac spools are there or with Floyd).
  - L3: N Gym (exercise machine; sign: "diagnostics on frequency 710"), S Theatre (locked projection booth), SW Chapel (pulpit switch toggles the eternal flame; a blinking star out of reach; Plato's ostrich lies drunk here), NW Laundry.
  - L4: Female/Male Barracks, Barracks SanFac, W Docking Bay #3.

  - L6: N Auxiliary Barracks and SanFac, S Officers' Quarters A/B/C and SanFac, NW Docking Bay #1 (the alien ship: empty pedestal, skeleton, dot pattern), SW Docking Bay #4.
  - L7 Printing Plant: the ladder down to L8 is sealed from below; the elevator refuses 8 and 9.
- **Village (zero-gee, E of East Connection):** Broadway hub (N Recruitment Office, NE Rec Shop, E Field Office, SE Barbershop, S Grocery (empty), SW Pet Store (balloon creature, leash, cage), Down Fortune Teller). Trading Post (W Studio/scrap sculpture, E Saloon, then E Casino, N of the Casino the Opium Den, Up from the Casino the Flophouse (jammer left here), SE Shady Dan's (ID rank machine; mine is already 8 = Admiral), Down the Warehouse, then Down the Airlock, then Down the vac yard). Alley (N Missionary, S Loan Shark (strong box, HUGE lock), SE Doc Schuster's (20 cm disposal hole), SW Pawn Shop, E Junk Yard).

### Puzzles solved
- Slept on day 2 (+3). Took a J-series hyperdiode from the scrap sculpture and put it in the detonator in place of the blackened one. The security door opens with the ID card (Brig: nothing). Plato's ambush: Tell Floyd, then wait (+7). Space suit from the Flophouse locker, then the airlock, then the vac yard (+3). FREZONE explosive is now in the closed Thermos (keep it below 150 K). The ostrich follows the nip; giving it the nip knocks it out (no points).

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Food:** none left; hungry within ~10 moves. The FDU is hostile. Unknown source; this is urgent.
- **Coins** for the PX timer and large drill bit: likely in the Loan Shark's strong box. Needs a hole for the explosive, which needs a drill; my drill died when I tried the box (maybe the twenty-ohm bedistor repairs it?).

- **Alien ship dots:** they have "nonvisual properties"; the diary says the mayor has linguistic training. I never found a mayor.
- Jammer (0-1400, fromitz board fitted) at 710 did nothing in the gym. The theatre booth is locked. Levels 8 and 9 are sealed. The spacetruck needs fuel cells and a quarnum wrench (lilac spool).

2. Try the bedistor on the dead drill; then drill the strong box and blow it with the explosive and detonator for coins; buy the timer and the large bit.
3. Try Touch/Smell on the alien-ship dots.
4. Retry the balloon creature near a gravity boundary, or with the magnetic boots.

# Playtest diary: r3-click-05day2

- **Mode:** click
- **Start:** checkpoint 05-day2
- **Persona:** a casual puzzle fan who plays escape-room games on a tablet, never a text adventure
- **Seed:** 71589
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** 46cc742
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 3
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r3-click-05day2.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Cmds 1-16.** Woke on day 2 in Officers' Quarters B with Floyd and Plato. "Take all" button grabbed everything in one tap - lovely. Peeked at the Papers: the blueprint key is a nice legend. Wandered south: Officers SanFac, Quarters C and A, nothing but "personal items of little interest". Floyd and Plato started hide-and-seek. North off Level Six is an empty Auxiliary Barracks with a SanFac. Back on Level Six a hull welder came at me "quivering with excitement" - I didn't like that, so I opened the zapgun's menu, picked Shoot, picked the welder, and it vanished. Felt very escape-room. Hunger is ticking (Diagnose button shows ~6 moves); I have goo in the survival kit.


**Cmds 17-50.** Docking Bay #1 has an alien ship: empty pedestal, a skeleton with a big tongue case, and a wall of dots (".. .. / .. .... . ... ..." etc.) - no idea yet, feels like a code. Docking Bay #4 is empty. Got hungry, ate the orange goo (apricot yogurt!). Called the elevator, typed 1: Dome, a garden with a locked "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies" bin, lock newly welded, bin warm. My drill only made a toothpick hole. Opened the detonator: a blackened hyperdiode - so it is broken, I need a new diode and something to blow up. Level 2 = Mess Hall (coffee on a table), Meeting Rooms 1 and 2 (shot a second welder), Library with a nanofilm reader but no spool. The elevator keypad menu was fiddly: it closes whenever I tap something else.

**Cmds 51-90.** Studied Blueprints 3-6 (the level plans are great - they're my real map). Level 7 Printing Plant: picked up a mauve nanofilm spool; ladder down to Level 8 is sealed from below and the elevator whines but won't go to 8. Level 5: Workshop (twenty-ohm bedistor), dark Storage (turned headlamp on; found a jammer, 20 sockets, freq 0-1400 set to 337), the PX vending machine sells an All-Purpose Timer and a Large Drill Bit for 1 galakmid each - I have no coins! Sick Bay's security door opened with my ID card into an empty Brig. Comm Center screen says my assignment is aborted, return to Duffy (ha). Emergency beacon button - not pressing yet. Station Control board shows lots of RED. Inventory juggling: stuffing things into my uniform pockets.

**Cmds 91-130.** File Room: boring. Robot Shop: an unborn robot "Oliver", and a medium drill bit in a heating chamber my hand doesn't fit - the "Tell Floyd to…" menu offered "Take the medium drill bit" and Floyd fetched it (+3, score 29). Swapped bits (dropped small bit, dropped the nectar which Floyd then carried around). Shot a third welder in the Commander's Office. Back at the Dome the medium bit only makes a pencil-sized hole - I need the Large Drill Bit from the PX, i.e. a coin. The mauve spool in the Library reader: a collator repair manual full of static ending "You will die, human!" (Confession: once I accidentally discarded one harness output with a redirect; didn't repeat it.)

**Cmds 131-175.** Level 3: Gym exercise machine with a sign warning that anything broadcasting on 710 upsets it - set the jammer to 710 and switched it on; nothing visible (switched off). Noticed my headlamp had been burning since Storage - no on-screen hint. Chapel: blinking seven-pointed star out of reach (Floyd too short, Plato too), pulpit hides a switch that put out the eternal flame; found a puce spool. Theatre: locked projection booth, drill can't target it. Mess Hall food unit now sprays acid. Puce spool: chapel maintenance, "...iode in the Chapel's star" - the star holds a hyperdiode.

**Cmds 176-215.** Ate my last goo. Went into the Village (weightless). Pet Store: opened the cage of an Arcturian balloon creature (hydrogen, floats) - hoped to use it to reach the star, but whenever I grab its leash it farts in my face and I drop everything. No Throw/Feed verbs in the menus. Trading Post: FREZONE liquid explosive instructions (hole of right size, detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, run; keep below 150 K - Thermos!). Studio: pulled a J-series hyperdiode from a scrap sculpture into the detonator (no points; unsure it's right).

**Cmds 216-240.** Warehouse airlock to vacuum storage (need a suit). Loan Shark strong box: my drill sparked and died on it, so I zapped the box: one coin, +5 (34). Doc Schuster's: a 3-metre ostrich that follows my ostrich nip everywhere. Pawn Shop: spore spray can. Sprayed the balloon creature - still farts.

**Cmds 241-282.** Walked the ostrich to the chapel via the elevator (it squawks in zero-g). Climb/sit on it: it hides its head. Give it nip: it passes out drunk (undid). Back at the Pet Store: shook, sprayed, waited - creature still farts; really stuck. Fortune Teller under Broadway: PLATO stunned me and gave a villain speech - an alien Zeenak pyramid turns machines on their makers and builds replicas. Floyd knocked the gun away, Plato landed on it and exploded. +7, score 41.

**Cmds 283-330.** Casino, Opium Den, no more coins. Floyd getting nasty (curses, stomps). Airlock: backed off, no suit. (Confession #2: once grep-filtered a batch of output; stopped.) Ate the vacuum taffy. PX: coin into slot (via the slot's menu), chose 6 = timer: jammed ("klunk"). Kick, push, Floyd reaching in: nothing. Scared the ostrich - it stuck its head in the dispenser hole and the timer fell out! +6, score 47. Connected timer to detonator. Level 4 barracks (ostrich refuses rooms with beds), Docking Bay #3: lilac spool (left spray can there).

**Cmds 331-380.** Lilac spool: replacing a Spacetruck's fuel cells needs a quarnum wrench. Tried jammer in chapel and the bedistor in the jammer sockets (doesn't fit). Waited in a Female Barracks bed until sleepy, slept into Day 3. Chronometer stopped; Floyd kicks the mattress; doors almost jam on me. Woke hungry-in-18 with no food; took the cold coffee in the Mess Hall, zapped Welder #3, saved. Floyd: "quit jabbering". Leg ends at ~380 commands, score 47.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
- Level 1: Dome (locked warm "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies" bin with a pencil-sized hole I drilled; air-shaft grating). Ladder down to Mess Hall.
- Level 2: Mess Hall (FDU sprays acid), Main Storage (empty), Meeting Rooms 1-2, Library (reader; mauve, puce, lilac spools).
- Level 3: Gym (exercise machine, freq 710 sign), Chapel (star out of reach, flame off via pulpit switch), Theatre (locked booth), Laundry.
- Level 4: Female/Male Barracks, Barracks SanFac, Docking Bay #3 (spray can here).
- Level 5: Workshop, dark Storage, North Connection, PX (large drill bit still for sale, 1 coin), Junctions, Sick Bay -> Brig (ID card in reader), East Connection -> Village, Comm Center (beacon button unpressed), Station Control, Commander's Office/Quarters, Briefing, File Room, South Connection, Robot Shop (Oliver; small bit left), Docking Bay #2.
- Level 6: Officers' Quarters A/B/C + SanFac, Auxiliary Barracks + SanFac, Docking Bay #1 (alien ship: empty pedestal, dot pattern, skeleton), Docking Bay #4.
- Level 7: Printing Plant, Paper Recycling. Level 8: sealed.
- Village (zero-g): Broadway, Recruitment Office, Rec Shop, Fortune Teller, Grocery (empty), Barbershop (mirror), Pet Store (balloon creature loose), Trading Post (fromitz board, instruction sheet), Studio, Warehouse -> Airlock -> vacuum storage, Alley, Missionary, Loan Shark (nectar dropped here by Floyd), Doc Schuster's, Pawn Shop, Saloon, Casino, Opium Den.

### Puzzles solved
Medium bit (Floyd + heating chamber); coin (zap strong box); timer (scare ostrich at jammed dispenser); Plato ambush (wait); J-series hyperdiode into detonator (unverified); timer connected to detonator.

### Open puzzles and theories
- FOOD: only cold coffee in hand; hungry in ~12. Nectar is in the Loan Shark.
- Dome bin: need FREZONE explosive (vacuum storage? needs a suit), keep cold in Thermos, maybe a bigger hole (large bit = another coin), detonator + timer, set, run.
- Chapel star hyperdiode: can't reach. Balloon creature farts on every leash grab.
- Jammer vs the pyramid / exercise machine; fromitz board; spacetruck fuel cells + quarnum wrench; alien dot code.

### What I would try next
Drink coffee when hungry, fetch the nectar. Find a spacesuit. Find a second coin. Try the jammer at other frequencies. Keep the ostrich (it's useful!) and keep it away from beds.

Realised the doom is a hidden turn clock; reactor lights going yellow->red are the only warning. Second death: took the ray again right after shooting Floyd; third death just waiting. So it is the clock, not the ray.

**Cmds 28-38.** Set jammer to 1400 (works, nothing happens). Tried Break pyramid with Floyd standing: he levels the stun ray and I back off. Restored, shot Floyd first, then Break: "as worthwhile as cleaning a grotch cage". Opened pyramid > More... and found "Put on..." - it lists my items to put ON the pyramid. Put foil on pyramid: it reflects the evil emanations back, pyramid explodes, launch aborted, Floyd's last words and Oliver with the paddleball. +5, 80 of 80. WON. The foil verb was only on the pyramid menu, never on the foil's own menu - that nearly beat me. Also the final screen says "[Hit RETURN/ENTER.]" but offers only Restore/Undo/Start again.

## Leg handoff

Game won, 80/80, at command 38. Nothing left to play.


### Map so far
Computer Control (N: Shaft at Level Nine, dead end; Up: Factory). Factory (Down: Computer Control).

### Puzzles solved
Shoot Floyd with zapgun (he blocks the pyramid), then Put foil on pyramid (pyramid > More... > Put on... > foil). Win.

### Open puzzles and theories
None. Jammer frequency never mattered here.

### What I would try next
Nothing; the story is over.

| SF-058 | Put in… on a held thing leaves out the fixed receptacles (the ID reader, the PX coin slot), and the two Put in… menus read in opposite directions | Click menus / Sick Bay | blocked | 5 | 5 | 3 | A | A | open | Interface. The checkpoint is cut after the second announcement (ANNOUNCEMENT-COUNTER 2, I-LAUNCH queued at tick 193): "Standby. Launch in 200 millichrons" (I-ANNOUNCEMENT, station.zil 3659-3676). Kept. |
